messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The EC tells the INQ about the change of his master data. The INQ notifies the IP of the change. The IP checks whether the master data can be changed at the desired time. The IP confirmes the changes of the INQ or the IP rejectes the changes of the INQ.

  <!-- PROCESS: EC -->

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EC_TellChange" name="Tell INQ About Change of Master Data">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EC_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EC" name="Change Requested">

    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EC_1" sourceRef="Start_EC" targetRef="Task_EC_TellChange" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EC_2" sourceRef="Task_EC_TellChange" targetRef="End_EC" />
  </bpmn:process>

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_INQ_NotifyIP" name="Notify IP of Change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_INQ_ReceiveResponse" name="Receive Response from IP">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgEvtDef_INQ_Response" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_INQ" name="Process Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_INQ_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_1" sourceRef="Start_INQ_Received" targetRef="Task_INQ_NotifyIP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_2" sourceRef="Task_INQ_NotifyIP" targetRef="Event_INQ_ReceiveResponse" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_INQ_3" sourceRef="Event_INQ_ReceiveResponse" targetRef="End_INQ" />
  </bpmn:process>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm Changes to INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IP_SendRejection" name="Reject Changes of INQ">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IP_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IP_4</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_1" sourceRef="Start_IP_Received" targetRef="Task_IP_CheckChange" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IP_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_IP_CheckResult" targetRef="Task_IP_SendConfirmation" />
